The problem says "equimolar mixture X of two liquids... is treated... then an equimolar mixture Y of two other liquids is formed". It does not say that X is a single compound that disproportionates. It says an equimolar mixture X forms an equimolar mixture Y. So the reaction is likely A + B -> C + D, with A and B in equimolar amounts, producing C and D in equimolar amounts. That's exactly cyclohexene + 1,4-cyclohexadiene -> benzene + cyclohexane.
